source.scope: Python implementation, research runners, native graphs/contracts and master configuration; no credentials or run payloads

schedule: Per source: 4 fixed shared ordinary primitive proposals; three graph/flat assembly proposals on growing fixed evidence; three same-library fresh proposals on final evidence; one no-library fresh proposal on final evidence. 42 calls total. All primitive attempts and qualification failures are retained; none is a silent retry or host-repaired output.
matching: Identical learned primitives, receipts, linker, executor and three assembly allowances. Flat may inline, rewrite, reuse and retain complete programs; fresh may use the same primitives.
graph: Content-addressed Python nodes and exact declared edges; initialization and readout calls are recorded by executor traces (not every transition step). A declared name or unused edge is not learned composition.
promotion: Latest valid candidate with development score >= incumbent, all regressions retained. Development labels are native observations. No protected feedback.
controls: Early graph program with final history/library, shared primitive with final history, empty history, cold, and single-shot no-library fresh (one rather than three proposals, diagnostic only). Neutral learned-child substitutions test effective dependence separately from invocation. All construction sealed before protected audit.
boundary: Three conditional configured-source replications in the disclosed native family; authored depth-three SQL compositions. No arbitrary semantic discovery or graph benefit implied by storage.
confirmation_boundary: One-time arm commitment before evaluating a separately frozen further-structure panel on the same configured sources. This is conditional further-case confirmation, not independent domain or learner replication. A new three-source paid run is a separate stronger replication.
